label: SYNTHETIC - LS-9 demonstration only. NOT a real landslide bulletin and NOT a real road closure.
description: A verified active closure on the Guwahati-Jorhat corridor. OFFICIAL verification + road_blocked=true is the only combination that reaches CRITICAL in assess_corridor, and CRITICAL is the only band in REJECTING_BANDS - so this yields REJECTED and the route cannot be selected or rerouted onto by anyone.
coordinate_provenance: latitude/longitude are sample[3] of the LS-9 demo route's own persisted geometry (backend route_risk.ROUTE_SAMPLES=5 over the real OSRM Guwahati-Jorhat line). Pinned from the route rather than guessed, so the incident is provably inside ON_ROUTE_BUFFER_M (5000 m) of a sampled position instead of being near the corridor by luck. It is a real place on that road - the NH-715 stretch by Bokakhat, below the Karbi Anglong hills - not an invented point.
